title: Gladstone Road or Disraeli Street? Victorian street names and the party the town voted for
excerpt: Victorian builders named thousands of streets after statesmen. I mapped them all: 405 Gladstones against 259 Beaconsfields and Disraelis. Liberal names won almost everywhere, and Liberal towns chose them only a little more often.
seo_description: Every UK street named after a Victorian statesman, mapped: 405 Gladstones, 259 Beaconsfields and Disraelis. Did names follow the vote?
header_alt: Title card reading 'Gladstone Road or Disraeli Street?' in orange and blue beside a map of Great Britain with orange dots for Liberal street names and blue dots for Conservative ones, and the line 405 Gladstones, 221 Beaconsfields, 38 Disraelis.
